wall.elevation-inverted: A wall's bottom elevation may not be above its top.

scene.auto-change-level-hint: When a token's movement ends at an elevation within another level, move it to that level (as a Change Level region would); below the lowest level it goes to the lowest, above the highest to the highest. Only works while the levels stack one on the next, with no gaps or overlaps.
scene.auto-change-level-unusable: This scene's levels overlap, leave gaps or are only one, so tokens are not moved between them.
scene.absolute-elevation-hint: Show and enter elevations on this scene as they are stored, instead of relative to the viewed level's bottom (token and placeable HUDs, tooltips, ruler labels).

region.optimized-already: This Region has a single shape: there is nothing to optimize.

tiles.control: Control the Tiles whose area you want as Shapes.
tiles.none: You are not controlling any Tiles!
tiles.empty: The controlled Tiles have no opaque area at this threshold.

options.smoothing-hint: How much the outline is smoothed. 0 is unsmoothed.
options.threshold-hint: How opaque a pixel must be to count. 0 is the tile rectangle.

barrier.label: Define Barrier
barrier.hint: Barriers at the Region's bottom, top or sides with options for restriction types and directions.

directions.out: Only going out of the Region

roof.ridge-hint: Where the ridge runs across the region (or across each tooth), in percent: 50 is a gable, 0 or 100 a shed (one face rising to that side), anything between a saltbox. Facing the direction, 0 is the left side.
roof.teeth-hint: How many times the roof repeats across the region: a sawtooth with the ridge at 0 or 100, a row of gables at 50.
roof.lowerGable-hint: How far up from the eaves each ridge end is a vertical gable end, in percent of the end's depth: 0 is a hip, 100 a gable, between a jerkinhead (half-hip).
roof.upperGable-hint: How far down from the ridge each ridge end is a gable set back on the hip, in percent of the end's depth: a Dutch gable. The hip is what the two gables leave between them; together at 100 or more, the end is all gable.
roof.pitch-hint: How steeply the roof rises from its eaves at the region's bottom (flattened when the region's top is lower than its ridge).

barrier-visualization.name: Barrier Visualization
barrier-visualization.hint: Use barriers to draw light, darkness, vision, and sound areas in 3D. Including accurate shadows.
